development_basis: Blocked FP64 tone fitting preserves development outputs but 5 MS/s tone-fit ARM smoke remains over budget. CI16 energy and lag products admit exact integer SIMD accumulation, avoiding FP64 arithmetic without a precision loss.
scope: Use original immutable CI16 only for exact energy and lag sums, widened to int64 before addition. Maximum 100000 samples keeps sums below 2^48. Floating-input replay keeps the FP64 fallback; all later tone and GLRT computations remain FP64.
algorithm_changes: Exact integer lag products use NEON on ARM and a scalar int64 fallback elsewhere, including unaligned sample counts and tail elements.
No narrowed search, reduced temporal support, threshold change, or new public result layout. Numerical parity remains mandatory.
